metaDescription: Order custom 4 xlarge lanyards badges for bulk events. Perfect for trade shows or employee IDs. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: For events where standard lanyards feel tight or uncomfortable, 4 xlarge lanyards provide the extra length needed for bulky clothing or larger attendees. Made from durable materials like woven polyester or nylon webbing, these oversized badges ensure your logo is visible without restricting movement. Ideal for outdoor trade shows or industrial site visits, they accommodate thick jackets or multiple card holders with ease. Add your company name via screen printing or woven text for a professional finish that stands out.
